positions.name: MeridianGateInstitution
positions.frame: what gate was instituted for Meridian deployments and on what grounds?
positions.why: Quinton's live declaration that every Meridian deployment requires a signed release manifest before it ships coheres with the distinct justification move that two unsigned artifacts reached staging last quarter and that is the whole reason for the gate—one directional read of institution plus grounds.

positions.name: MeridianGateDecisionTerms
positions.frame: what terms were settled for the Meridian release-train deployment gate?
positions.why: The three conversation-level summary lines (Gate, Scope, Owner), each under principal session, cohere as the settled decision package for the Meridian release train: the signed-manifest requirement, its application to staging and production, and Quinton Fairweather as owner.
